title: Infrastructure Engineer - AI Platforms
description:
Infrastructure Engineer | 6 Month Contract | Inside IR35 | Hybrid Working | Birmingham | £450pd-£550pd


We're looking for an experienced Infrastructure Engineer to support the roll-out and ongoing management of enterprise AI platforms within a large UK organisation.

This is a hands-on infrastructure role combining strong Azure, Entra ID and IAM experience with exposure to enterprise AI technologies.

This is NOT an AI Developer or Data Science role. We're looking for an Infrastructure Engineer who understands how AI platforms are deployed, secured, integrated and supported within an enterprise environment.

What you'll be doing
  • Supporting Azure infrastructure and environments for AI platforms.
  • Managing Entra ID, user groups, permissions and access controls.
  • Configuring SSO, IAM and RBAC.
  • Supporting the roll-out and integration of new AI tools.
  • Managing user provisioning, platform access and licensing.
  • Troubleshooting authentication, access and infrastructure issues.
  • Working with security, infrastructure and business teams to ensure platforms are securely configured and governed.
What we're looking for
  • Strong Microsoft Azure and Entra ID experience.
  • Identity & Access Management, SSO and RBAC.
  • Cloud infrastructure and SaaS administration.
  • Enterprise application integration and troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting the roll-out or management of enterprise AI platforms.
  • Exposure to Claude Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot or similar AI technologies would be highly beneficial.


If you feel like you have the relevant experience, please click on the link and apply for immediate consideration.
